responsibility: Provides the diagnostics and suggestion-building logic used during HIR type lowering for malformed generic arguments, invalid `Fn`-trait syntax, unresolved or mismatched associated items, and related type-lowering failures.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `errors.rs`, this file is narrowly scoped to diagnostics emitted while lowering HIR types and paths, with suggestion-building tied to generic arguments, `Fn`-trait syntax, and associated-item lookup during lowering.
